observation: SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Theorem 2.1 proof: `\underline D_X=\underline D` should identify `\underline D_K`, as in the French.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Lemma 2.2 proof: `\uH^i(P'_{\ol{x}})` remains underlined although the corrected French has plain cohomology; C143 only covers the expression for \(P\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Lemma 2.2 proof: the references SGAA VIII 7.2 and VIII 7.7 accompanying specialization morphisms are omitted.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, 3.1.2: the bis conditions are numbered `(i bis)` and `(ii bis)`, rather than `(ii bis)` and `(iii bis)`.

SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Corollary 1.13 editorial footnote: the claim that the displayed chain needs Proposition 1.12(a)(ii) is incorrect; properness identifies \(\R f_*\) with \(\R_!f\), so two applications of (a)(i) suffice.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, page 70: “By purity, however,” omits the French reference “(4.3)”.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, diagram 2.4.1: the upper horizontal arrow is reversed; it should run from \((E,F)\) to \((E_1\otimes_S^L P_2,F_1\otimes_S^L Q_2)\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of Lemma 2.6.3(a): “the sums of this square” should be “the vertices [or terms] of this square”.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, explanation following Proposition 3.4: \(A_{X_2}\xrightarrow{\sim}f_2^!A_{Y_2}\) should use \(f_2^*\), as in the corrected French.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, final sentence of §3.5: the path \(f_{2*}(4)\circ(2)\) must also be inverted to describe \(f_*u\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, explanation of 3.7.3: \(g'_*d'^!\) should be \(g'_*c'^!\); \(d'\) is not defined there.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, explanation of 4.2.6: \(E''=C'\times_{X'}D'\) should have base \(X\), not the undefined \(X'\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §5.2: the base-change arrow’s target has \(p_{23}^*p_{23,2}^*L_2\), whereas the corrected French has \(p_{23}^!p_{23,2}^*L_2\); C527 only covers the source.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (6.8.1): the English has \(\cl^d_{X/S}(Y)\), whereas the corrected French has \(\cl_{X/S}(Y)\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (6.8.2): the nonzero case uses global \(\Hom\), whereas the corrected French uses sheaf \(\underline{\Hom}\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §1.4: the target of \((Du)_z\) is written \((DM)_x\), but should be \((DL)_x\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Corollary 1.5: the pair \((\{y\}\times Y,B)\) should be \((\{x\}\times Y,B)\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of Lemma 2.3: the four tensor products in the two canonical-isomorphism displays have subscript `\Lambda`; the corrected French has subscript `S`.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §2.6: `f:T-Z\hookrightarrow T` should have domain `T-Y`, as in the corrected French.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §3.2: the definition of \(E'\) uses `\lten_{\Lambda}` twice, whereas the corrected French uses `\otimes_S`.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Lemma 3.5: the diagram omits the vertical arrow \(f:X'\to X\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of 3.3: both diagrams involving \(A'_{i'}\) and \(B'_{j'}\) omit the vertical arrow \(X'\to X\).

SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Lemma 4.3: the upper-left vertical arrow should be labelled \(j'\); the lower vertical inclusions should point upward and be labelled \(m'\) on the left and \(m\) on the right.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of 4.3, first displayed isomorphism: both occurrences of \(Rj_*\) on the right should be \(Rj'_*\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of 4.3(b): both horizontal arrows in the diagram of schemes point in the wrong direction.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of 4.3(c): the strict localization \(\widetilde Z\) used with \(\widetilde C\) must be at \(\bar s\), not \(\bar z\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of 4.2: the exceptional divisor is written \(\mathbb P^1_S\), whereas the corrected French has \(\mathbb P^1_s\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of 4.2, display (*): the target uses \(B'\cup D\) and restricts to the empty set \(B'-(B'\cup D)\); the restriction should concern \(B'-D\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, discussion after (5.7.4): the trace homomorphism of complexes should target \(A_\natural\), not \(A\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §5.9 and (5.9.1): global \(\RHom\) appears where sheaf \(\uRHom\) is required.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (5.9.1): the left-hand tensor products over \(A^e\) and \(B^e\) are ill-typed; the evaluation arrows use tensor products over \(A\) and \(B\), respectively.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, hypothesis before (5.9.1): the indicated Hom complex is a right \(B\)-module, so the boundedness category should be \(D^b(B^\circ)\), not \(D^b((B^e)^\circ)\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, explanation after (5.9.1): the evaluation arrows (1) and (2) correspond to (5.3.5), not (5.3.6).

SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §§5.9–5.13: numerous sheaf \uHom and \uRHom expressions in the supplied French contexts appear as plain \Hom and \RHom in English, independently of the targeted corrections above.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, hypothesis before 5.9.1: the English has \(D^b((B^e)^\circ)\), whereas the corrected French has \(D^b(B^\circ)\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, 5.9.1: the two left-hand tensor subscripts are \(A^e\) and \(B^e\) in English, but \(A\) and \(B\) in French.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, hypothesis before 5.9.2: the English replaces the French \((F\lten_{A^e}B^e)\lten_AG\) with \((F\lten_{A^e}B^e)\lten_B(B\lten_AG)\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, paragraph following 5.10.1: \(\Tr_A(f_g)\) should read \(\Tr_A(fg)\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, setup for 5.10.3: \({}^BP_A\) should be \({}_BP_A\), indicating a left \(B\)-module.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, triangle in the proof of 5.10.6: the French diagram label \((*)\) is absent.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, evaluation arrow immediately before 5.10.8: the English has \(\lten_{B^e}E\), whereas the corrected French has \(\lten_BE\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of 5.10.11: “conjugate 5.10.6 and 5.10.9” mistranslates “conjuguer”; the intended meaning is “combine 5.10.6 and 5.10.9.”
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (6.2.1): the English has \(f_{1!}\) and \(f_{2!}\), whereas the corrected French has \(f_{1*}\) and \(f_{2*}\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (6.2.2): the two factors should use \(f_1^!M_1\) and \(f_2^!M_2\), not \(f^!M_1\) and \(f^!M_2\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (6.3.1): `t_A^!` should be `t^!A`, as in the corrected French.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §6.4: the application of 6.2.3 should specify \(F_1=KA_{X_1}\), not \(E_2=KA_{X_1}\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, before (6.5.7): applying `i^cc^!` should instead mean applying `i_*^ci^{c!}`, as in the corrected French.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (6.5.7): the English has the extraneous superscript in `c_*^c`; the corrected French has `c_*`.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (6.6.4): the bars on \(v\) are absent from the corrected French, which has \(\Tr_A(vu)=\Tr_A(uv)\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §6.9: \(D_c({}_AX)=D_c({}_{A[G]}X)\) is missing \(G\) on the left; this error is also present in the supplied French context.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §6.13: \(f_*M_n\) uses an undefined \(M_n\); the system introduced there is \(L_n\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §6.14: the filtration simultaneously specifies \(F^1\Lambda_X=i_!\Lambda_U\) and \(F^n\Lambda_X=0\) for \(n\ge1\); the latter bound should be \(n\ge2\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, the formula for \(\operatorname{gr}^1\underline c\): its target should involve \(\Lambda_{U,X}\), not \(\Lambda_{X-U,X}\); the supplied French retains this error.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (6.14.4): `\underline c_{X-U,U}` differs from the corrected French `\underline c_{X-U,X}`.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, §6.14: “We write \(\underline c\), \(\underline c_{U,X}\), and so on, when we want to specify the base ring” supplies no notation specifying that ring.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, the paragraph before §6.18: “every point \(x\) of \(G\)” should refer to points of \(C\), the domain of \(c_1\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Proposition 6.19: \(f_*M\) is ill-typed because \(M\) is on \(Y\); the required hypothesis concerns \(f_*L\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Proposition 6.21: “proper \(G\)-morphism” omits the \(S\) in the corrected French’s “\(G\)-\(S\)-morphism.”
Page 199: the proof refers to arrows (1)–(5) and squares (A), (B), but these labels are absent from the English diagram.
Pages 201–202, Lemma 6.23.3: the sheaf-derived Hom terms are written with plain `\RHom`, losing the distinction from the global derived Hom factors.
Page 202, §6.24: “conjugating 6.23.1 with the Lefschetz formula” mistranslates combining the two formulas.
Page 206, §1.2: the inner `\uHom_A` in the displayed representability identity should denote ordinary Hom of modules, not sheaf Hom.
Page 216, §2.4.3: “the set of isomorphisms” defining `\Hom'_{AR}(X,Y)` should be “the set of morphisms”.
Page 224, §4.1.1: the text refers to diagram (D), but the English diagram has no such label.

SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, heading “Properties of \(E(X)\)”: the spectral-sequence symbol remains plain \(E\), whereas the corrected French heading uses \(\mathbb{E}\).
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, (5.1): the product in `h=f\circ g:\prod_iD_i\to S` is missing the base subscript \(X\) present in the French.

SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of 6.1: the two diagrams lack the labels \((D_1)\) and \((D_2)\) used in the ensuing text.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, proof of Lemma 9.4: the English omits the parenthetical statement that proving \(b_0=0\) is equivalent by (9.1.1).

SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, before (9.4.6): the English omits the equality \(f_1^*u_*(1)=f_1^*(X\times1)\) and the disjointness \(\widehat N\cap f_1^{-1}(X\times1)=\emptyset\) used to justify the vanishing.

SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, p.365: The displayed definition of the left derived functor lacks the superscript minus present in the corrected French context; no id in this batch targets that occurrence.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, p.371: “cf. SGA 3 I 4.7.2).” has an unmatched closing parenthesis.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, p.373: The second equivariance condition lacks the label “b)” shown in the corrected French context.

SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, before §3: “Weil formula 6.1” and “local invariants … in no. 5” conflict with the displayed numbering: the Weil formula is (5.2), and the local terms are defined in §6.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, Proposition 3.6: “defined in 4.1” appears to refer to the construction in 3.4, not Lemma 4.1.
SGA5_English_sync_workpass.tex, after (3.7.2): the reference “(4.3.1)” should apparently be “(3.7.1)”.
